subject: English
passage: At twelve chapters long, the environmental protection law of ______ nation in Southeast Asia—contains significantly more detail than the brief three-chapter environmental statute in neighboring countries.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is the punctuation of a supplementary element within a sentence. The dash after "Thailand" pairs with the dash after "Asia" to separate the supplementary element "a nation in Southeast Asia" from the rest of the sentence.
